stem: Ravi observes a small pond near his school in Pune. He notes all the Rohu fish in the pond, the water plants, the insects, and also the water, sunlight and mud, and how they interact. Which term best describes everything Ravi has observed?

options.text: A population, because the Rohu fish are one kind of organism
An ecosystem, because both living organisms and non-living components are included
A community, because there is more than one kind of living organism
A habitat, because the pond is where the organisms live

teacher.key_rationale: The observation includes multiple kinds of living organisms (fish, plants, insects) together with non-living components (water, sunlight, mud) and their interactions, so it is best described as an ecosystem. Option A names only one kind of organism (the trap for a student who fixes on the fish alone), C omits the abiotic components, and D refers only to the place, not the interacting system.
